Commercial and industrial refrigeration repair: the most common faults

Supermarket, cutting plant, logistics warehouse or production site: commercial and industrial refrigeration calls for carefully sized and closely monitored systems. FrigAirco looks after refrigeration packs, condensing units, evaporators and refrigerated cabinets.

  • Refrigeration pack or condensing unit in fault
  • Compressor on high-pressure or low-pressure cut-out
  • Refrigerant leak on the pipework
  • Evaporator blocked with ice, defrost failure
  • Fault on the controls, expansion valve or electrical panel

How does a commercial and industrial refrigeration repair work?

  1. 1

    You call or message us on WhatsApp

    Describe the fault: we reply quickly, at any hour.

  2. 2

    On-site diagnosis

    The technician finds the cause of the fault and explains what needs to be done.

  3. 3

    Repair

    Replacing the faulty part, repairing the leak, recharging refrigerant if needed.

  4. 4

    Restart

    Temperature checks and advice to keep the fault from coming back.

Frequently asked questions

Do you come out at night and at weekends for commercial and industrial refrigeration repair?

Yes. Commercial and industrial refrigeration repair is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, public holidays included. Call us or send a WhatsApp message.

Where do you offer commercial and industrial refrigeration repair?

Anywhere in Belgium: Wallonia, Brussels and Flanders.

What should I do while waiting for the technician?

Note the error code or the temperature shown, avoid restarting the unit several times in a row and, for food refrigeration, keep the doors closed to hold the cold.
